summary: Frontend-only validation of the new 'Analyser le plan (tout)' one-click orchestrator on /plan for the pro user. Logged in as pro@construpilot.fr, uploaded /app/test_metre.pdf, and verified both the uncalibrated guard and the full chain after calibration. All 5 acceptance criteria are met: (1) guard toast shown when uncalibrated with no crash, (2) after 2-point calibration the single click triggers detect-structure -> analyze -> refreshPlan -> importAiRooms -> loadDescriptif -> runEstimation, (3) loading toast 'Analyse complète en cours… structure, pièces, métré et estimation.' appears, (4) success toast 'Plan analysé automatiquement — 0 murs · 0 poteaux · 0 poutres · 0 dalles. Métré, pièces et estimation prêts.' appears (0 counts are expected on this minimal test PDF as per reviewer note), (5) button re-enables and returns to text 'Analyser le plan (tout)'. No uncaught JS exceptions (pageerror) observed during the full flow. Total chain time ~12–15s.
critical_code_review_comments: During the chain, a 400 network error is emitted (likely by /estimate-from-takeoff when the métré has no rooms/measures). It is caught in the try/catch and does not break the chain, but it pollutes the browser console with 'Failed to load resource: 400'. Consider silencing/guarding the estimation call when takeoff has no measurable items, or intercepting axios errors for these best-effort calls so they don't hit console.error.

PlanTakeoff.jsx is ~4538 lines — well above the 700-line guideline. Splitting orchestrator (analyzePlanFull), calibration, tools handlers and dialogs into hooks/modules would greatly improve maintainability. This has been flagged in earlier iterations.
seed_data_creation: Uploaded /app/test_metre.pdf via /plan; calibrated with two_points p1=[300,300] p2=[500,300] real=5 m (80 px/m).
context_for_next_testing_agent: The 'Analyser le plan (tout)' button (data-testid='plan-analyze-btn') is fully wired to analyzePlanFull() in PlanTakeoff.jsx L1264. Uncalibrated guard verified. Full happy-path chain verified on the vector test_metre.pdf (0 walls / 0 rooms is expected). Calibration through UI works: select tool-calibrate, click 2 canvas points, fill #calib-dist, confirm with calib-confirm-btn. If future PDFs contain content, the analyze chain should populate rooms and structure overlay accordingly.
rca of the issue: No blocking issue. Minor console noise from a 400 on the estimation endpoint when the métré is empty — cosmetic only, chain still shows success toast and re-enables the button.
